title: Mediation invitation responses
bodyMd:
The table counts invited parties and parties accepting an invitation. Acceptance does not imply that mediation ultimately succeeds.

| Category | Invited parties | Accepted |
|---|---:|---:|
| Housing | 100 | 45 |
| Consumer | 120 | 72 |
| Neighbour | 180 | 126 |
